mapper.select: SELECT request_no as requestNo, request_name as requestName FROM special_request

select rm.room_qty - IFNULL(sum(rs.room_no), 0) from room rm left outer join reservation rs on rm.room_no = rs.room_no and #{getDate} between STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkin_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(rs.checkout_date, '%Y-%m-%d') where rm.accommodation_no = #{accommodationNo} and rm.room_no = #{roomNo} group by rm.room_no
